missions.title: Ashen Heaven
missions.description: You are the ultimate goal of my life.

missions.title: Birth Of The Devil
missions.description: The bitter rain falls relentlessly and everything seems unreal, like dew or lightning.

missions.title: The Truth
missions.description: ...Love led us to one life... Love led us to one death.

missions.title: The Goddess' Response
missions.description: "If my heart had not entered the flame..." "My blood would have followed you onward..."

missions.title: Accolade
missions.description: "William, I've brought you a gift you will love..."

missions.title: Reichenbach Symphony I
missions.description: "You must be a very good dog..."

missions.title: Reichenbach Symphony II
missions.description: "No matter where you might be, I shall bring you death."
